novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a mechanism/measurement hypothesis: a “single low-dimensional linear subspace” for an agent’s believes-true versus believes-false state that is “distinct from the model's own truth encoding,” plus the proposed relationship that attribution errors arise from “the truth direction leaking into the belief readout.” Searches using “LLM attributed belief linear probe activation steering,” “false belief truth direction mechanistic interpretability,” and “belief representation activation editing language models” identify the closest prior work as Brittle Minds, Fixable Activations: Understanding Belief Representations in Language Models (EMNLP 2024), which already probes internal representations of others’ beliefs and causally corrects ToM inferences through activation edits; truth-direction probing is also established by Marks and Tegmark (2023) and related work. Separating the existing belief and factual-truth representations geometrically and attributing false-belief failures specifically to cross-direction leakage is a substantive multi-step integration, but it is a natural extension of those two established lines rather than a wholly new interpretability principle.
